title: Token-latency-aware memory amortization ledger for weights/KV/activations
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Implement an amortization-based memory accounting layer ("ledger") that tracks and enforces headroom budgets across three primary consumers on serving GPUs: model weights (including quantized/FP variants), KV cache shards, and transient activations. The ledger will be token-latency-aware: it attributes memory cost across inflight tokens and microbursts so autoscaling and eviction policies can make locality- and latency-informed decisions. Goal: reduce OOMs and tail latency regressions during mixed workloads while improving utilization and lowering per-token cost.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger must report per-GPU breakdown: weights | KV | activations | reserved_headroom in reporter API

Integrate ledger signals with existing KV eviction and continuous batching controller so that eviction decisions prefer KV slice rotation over weight offload when predicted tail latency impact is higher
Demonstrate 15% reduction in OOM incidents on mixed-priority workloads in staging against baseline for a 4-week synthetic trace
End-to-end telemetry charts in Console showing amortized token-cost estimates (tokens/sec vs memory utilization) for top 5 customers
Performance overhead under 2% p99 CPU and <1% p50 latency for decision path in common steady-state workloads
comments: 2025-01-16 - Ava Martinez: Kickoff meeting notes: aligned on why amortization gives better eviction signals than instantaneous watermarks. Decided to prototype ledger as a lightweight in-memory store with periodic checkpoints to RocksDB.

2025-01-22 - Daniel Kim: Spike complete. Implemented token-time profile sampler that emits per-request lifetime (arrival->completion). Observed that microburst tails cause ~2GB transient activation spikes with common chat workloads.
2025-01-30 - Design review (Jo Chen): Recommended exposing 'soft-reserve' vs 'hard-reserve' buckets. Soft-reserve can be borrowed by low-latency background jobs with preemption callbacks.

2025-02-03 - Engineering sync: Chose amortization window of 30s for continuous-batching baseline after tradeoff analysis (shorter windows more reactive but higher churn; longer windows risk under-reacting to bursts). We will make window tunable per pool.
2025-02-07 - QA (Rajat Singh): Added fuzz tests for ledger under synthetic mixed-priority traces. Found a bug where quantized shadow weights were double-counted; patch submitted.
2025-02-11 - PR 7624: Initial ledger integration and telemetry metrics. Requesting review from runtime infra and console teams. Noted a small CPU overhead in telemetry marshal path.
2025-02-14 - Feedback from Console PM (Marta Lopez): Telemetry naming should align with Console vocabulary (amortized_memory -> token_amortized_bytes). Will update before merging.

2025-02-18 - Ops (Khaled Farouk): Deployed to staging with conservative defaults (soft-reserve=8% headroom, amortization_window=30s). Observed one-restart for an older driver variant; investigation shows ledger checkpoint IO contended with checkpointing service. Mitigation: jitter checkpoint intervals and async flush.

2025-02-21 - Experiment results: On mixed chat+batch workload, KV slice rotation reduced p99 latency spikes by 22% vs baseline when ledger preferred KV eviction over weight offload. Activation spill to host still costly; next step: explore preemptive activation compression for cold tokens.
2025-02-25 - Security review note: No customer data is persisted in ledger checkpoints; only aggregate counters and shard IDs. Confirmed with security team (ticket SEC-9032).

2025-02-28 - Daniel Kim: Roadmap update: address activation compression spike, add per-tenant priority weighting, and roll out to Dedicated pilot. Plan to close ticket after Dedicated pilot (target 2025-03-15).
